arStrings.szText: "Now then. What must be done next?"
Now, we must clean this mess. And then stop Hatred from making another anywhere near the Tree.
Bracing for task to come. Daunting.
The heads once spoke of a cleansing ritual from the days when the Great Serpent was young...one that invoked the Tree's ancient name.
Shy. Offering an idea. Enjoys the history.
They said Belith the Elder knew this name, but...her head was taken. To the Fractured Peaks, the whispers think.
Enjoys talking about the heads. Shyness returns in the end.
And for years, I thought you spent too much time round this damned Tree.
Pleasantly surprised. A swell of pride in Ouna.
We are fortunate she has. Wanderer, seek this Belith in the Fractured Peaks and bring back her head. We have a ritual to prepare for.
Impressed. Pleased to have a plan.
